sqlStatement:
WITH LabItemList AS (
    SELECT v.ItemID
    FROM (VALUES
        ('102508'), ('102509'), ('3010023'), ('3010025'), ('3010058'), ('3010099'), ('3010195'), ('3010197'), ('3010242'), ('3010243'), ('3010389'), ('3010394'), ('3010491'), ('3010510'), ('3010639'), ('3010641'), ('3010642'), ('3010782'), ('3010949'), ('3010985'), ('3011025'), ('3011834'), ('3012456'), ('3013300'), ('3013434'), ('3013699'), ('3018004'), ('3018005'), ('3018009'), ('3023033'), ('3023896'), ('3030012'), ('3030032'), ('3030055'), ('3030090'), ('3030131'), ('3030133'), ('3030149'), ('3030280'), ('3030283'), ('3030455'), ('3030493'), ('3030718'), ('3030972'), ('3031183'), ('3176/5ML'), ('600229'), ('607001'), ('607002'), ('607005'), ('607014'), ('607037'), ('607094'), ('607096'), ('607099'), ('607109'), ('607110'), ('607116'), ('607147'), ('607148'), ('607212'), ('607213'), ('607250'), ('607251'), ('607252'), ('607254'), ('607316'), ('607317'), ('607345'), ('607392'), ('607576'), ('607701'), ('607704'), ('607714'), ('607715'), ('607716'), ('607717'), ('608210'), ('608512'), ('640000')
    ) v(ItemID)
),
LabConjItemList AS (
    SELECT v.ItemID
    FROM (VALUES
        ('674842'), ('680499'), ('698134'), ('698528'), ('680683'), ('673260'), ('670430'), ('565357'), ('680479'), ('672361'), ('670185'), ('670956'), ('672693'), ('675823'), ('698623'), ('670624'), ('676670'), ('680166'), ('670366'), ('680143'), ('674940'), ('672970'), ('680484'), ('672347'), ('568210'), ('670716'), ('680790'), ('670583'), ('679910'), ('672002'), ('680146')
    ) v(ItemID)
),
Inv_location AS (
    SELECT
        A.ITEMID,
        SUM(A.PHYSICALINVENT)  AS PHYSICALINVENTORY,
        SUM(A.AVAILPHYSICAL)   AS AVAILABLEPHYSICAL,
        SUM(A.RESERVPHYSICAL)  AS RESERVPHYSICAL,
        SUM(A.ONORDER)         AS ONORDER,
        SUM(A.ORDERED)         AS ORDERED,
        A.INVENTDIMID,
        B.INVENTLOCATIONID,
        B.WMSLOCATIONID,
        B.INVENTSTATUSID,
        B.INVENTBATCHID,
        C.EXPDATE,
        C.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE,
        D.FILTERCODE,
        E.[Buyer Group ID],
        E.[Item Name],
        itm.[UNITID] AS UOM
    FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[INVENTSUM_V] A
    LEFT JOIN [INVENTDIM_V] B
        ON A.INVENTDIMID = B.INVENTDIMID
       AND A.DATAAREAID = B.DATAAREAID
       AND A.[PARTITION] = B.[PARTITION]
    LEFT JOIN [INVENTBATCH_V] C
        ON A.ITEMID = C.ITEMID
       AND A.DATAAREAID = C.DATAAREAID
       AND B.INVENTBATCHID = C.INVENTBATCHID
       AND B.[PARTITION] = C.[PARTITION]
    LEFT JOIN [WHSINVENTTABLE_V] D
        ON A.ITEMID = D.ITEMID
       AND A.DATAAREAID = D.DATAAREAID
       AND A.[PARTITION] = D.[PARTITION]
    LEFT JOIN [Item_V] E
        ON A.ITEMID = E.[Item ID]
       AND A.DATAAREAID = E.Company
       AND A.[PARTITION] = E.[PARTITION]
    LEFT JOIN INVENTTABLEMODULE_V itm
    ON E.[Item ID] = itm.ITEMID
    AND E.Company  = itm.DATAAREAID
    AND itm.[MODULETYPE] = 0
    WHERE A.DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
    GROUP BY
        A.ITEMID, A.INVENTDIMID, B.INVENTLOCATIONID, B.WMSLOCATIONID,
        B.INVENTSTATUSID, B.INVENTBATCHID,
        C.EXPDATE, C.PDSBESTBEFOREDATE,
        D.FILTERCODE, E.[Buyer Group ID], E.[Item Name], itm.[UNITID]
),
WHS_location AS (
    SELECT ZONEID, WMSLOCATIONID, INVENTLOCATIONID
    FROM [WMSLOCATION_V]
    WHERE DATAAREAID = 'rdsi'
      AND INVENTLOCATIONID NOT IN ('BT-Q','BT-DIST','BT-EXP')
)
SELECT
    A.*,
    B.ZONEID,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(A.WMSLOCATIONID,'') IN ('PS-REC','REC','FLR','STEM-4','v','FG-RCV','FG-LOST','ac','Albert','AUTO','Cas','CG','DEFAULT','DOCK','GEN','Gs','jf','jm','jw','lw','mdk','ms','Ms','PS-SAREPTA','PS-UTABLE','REC2','RECV','RESERVED','RETAIN','RMA','SHP-SUPPLY','v2', 'Exclude')
            THEN 'Other'
        WHEN A.[Buyer Group ID] IN ('P28','P38','P48','P58') THEN 'velvet'
        WHEN L.ItemID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lab'
        WHEN C.ItemID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lab'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS Team,
    CASE
        WHEN L.ItemID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lab-James'
        WHEN C.ItemID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Lab-Christian'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS LabSplit
FROM Inv_location A
LEFT JOIN WHS_location B
    ON A.WMSLOCATIONID = B.WMSLOCATIONID
   AND A.INVENTLOCATIONID = B.INVENTLOCATIONID
LEFT JOIN LabItemList L
    ON A.ITEMID = L.ItemID
LEFT JOIN LabConjItemList C
    ON A.ITEMID = C.ItemID
WHERE A.INVENTLOCATIONID NOT IN ('BT-DIST','BT-EXP','BT-Q')
  AND A.Team <> 'Other'
description: Complex query retrieving inventory locations and physical inventory data for Lab and Velvet team items. Uses CTEs for item categorization and filters by company 'rdsi'. Assigns team classification based on buyer group and item list membership.

sqlStatement:
SELECT
    A.*,
    B.[Journal Name],
    C.WMSLOCATIONID,
    C.INVENTLOCATIONID,
    C.INVENTSTATUSID
FROM [dbo].[Inventory Journal Transactions_V] A
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Inventory Journal Document_V] B
    ON A.[Journal ID] = B.[Journal ID]
    AND A.Company = B.Company
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[INVENTDIM_V] C
    ON A.[Inventory Dimension ID] = C.INVENTDIMID
    AND A.[Inventory Batch ID] = C.[INVENTBATCHID]
    AND A.Company = C.DATAAREAID
WHERE
    B.[Journal Name] = 'COUNT'
    AND A.Company = 'rdsi'
ORDER BY
    A.[Transaction Date] DESC
description: Retrieves all inventory cycle count transaction records by joining Journal Transactions with Journal Documents and Inventory Dimensions. Filters for transactions where Journal Name = 'COUNT' and Company = 'rdsi'. Results ordered by Transaction Date descending.

sqlStatement:
SELECT *
FROM MAS90CBS.dbo.IM_ItemCost
WHERE WarehouseCode IN ('000', 'C01', 'C02', 'C03')
description: Retrieves item cost records from MAS90CBS ERP system. Filters for warehouse codes 000, C01, C02, C03. Creates composite ITEM+BATCH key and deduplicates by LotSerialNo.

sqlStatement:
WITH UserList AS (
    SELECT UPPER('Logan.Ky')   AS PostedUserID UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('adam.ols')               UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Zakkary.')                 UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('salkowfr')               UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Travis.R')              UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Coryg')                  UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('winterle')              UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Alex.Car')             UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Alexand3')            UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Brennen.')              UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('David.Hu')              UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Jamiek')                UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Jordan.1')               UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Liisa.Je')               UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Michae10')             UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Nick.Sly')              UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Sam.McNu')              UNION ALL
    SELECT UPPER('Shanika.')
),
Base AS (
    SELECT
        A.[Journal ID],
        B.[Journal Name],
        B.[Journal Name Description],
        B.[Journal Type],
        B.[Posted Y/N],
        B.Description,
        A.[Item ID],
        A.[Inventory Batch ID],
        A.[Inventory Dimension ID],
        A.[Inventory Location ID],
        A.Quantity,
        A.[Transaction Date],
        A.[Posted User ID]
    FROM dbo.[Inventory Journal Transactions_V] A
    LEFT JOIN dbo.[Inventory Journal Document_V] B
           ON A.[Journal ID] = B.[Journal ID]
          AND A.Company      = B.Company
    WHERE
        A.Company = 'rdsi'
        AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(B.[Posted Y/N], '')))) IN ('YES','Y','TRUE','1')
        AND A.[Transaction Date] >= DATEADD(DAY, -14, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))
),
Classified AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN [Journal Type] = 'Transfer' THEN 'TRANSFER'
            WHEN [Journal Type] = 'Movement' THEN 'MOVEMENT'
            ELSE 'OTHER'
        END AS ActivityType
    FROM Base
),
Transfer_and_Movement AS (
    SELECT
        ActivityType,
        [Item ID],
        [Journal ID],
        [Journal Name],
        [Journal Name Description],
        [Journal Type],
        [Posted Y/N],
        Description,
        [Inventory Batch ID],
        [Inventory Dimension ID],
        [Inventory Location ID],
        Quantity,
        CAST([Transaction Date] AS datetime) AS [Transaction Date],
        [Posted User ID]
    FROM Classified R
    JOIN UserList U
      ON UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(R.[Posted User ID]))) = U.PostedUserID
    WHERE
        ActivityType IN ('TRANSFER','MOVEMENT')
        AND R.[Inventory Location ID] IN ('BT','BT-OPS')
),
PurchaseOrder AS (
    SELECT
        'PURCHASE_ORDER' AS ActivityType,
        A.[Item ID] AS [Item ID],
        CAST(NULL AS varchar(50))  AS [Journal ID],
        CAST(NULL AS varchar(50))  AS [Journal Name],
        CAST(NULL AS varchar(200)) AS [Journal Name Description],
        CAST(NULL AS varchar(50))  AS [Journal Type],
        CAST(NULL AS varchar(10))  AS [Posted Y/N],
        CAST(NULL AS varchar(500)) AS [Description],
        D.INVENTBATCHID            AS [Inventory Batch ID],
        A.[INVENTDIMID]            AS [Inventory Dimension ID],
        A.[Inventory Location ID]  AS [Inventory Location ID],
        CAST(A.[Inbound Quantity] AS decimal(18,6)) AS Quantity,
        CAST(A.[Date Physical]    AS datetime)      AS [Transaction Date],
        CAST(NULL AS varchar(50)) AS [Posted User ID]
    FROM [JetAxDwh].[dbo].[Inventory Transactions_V] A
    LEFT JOIN dbo.INVENTDIM_V D
      ON D.INVENTDIMID = A.INVENTDIMID
     AND D.DATAAREAID  = A.[Company]
    WHERE
        A.Company = 'rdsi'
        AND A.[Inventory Location ID] IN ('BT','BT-OPS')
        AND A.[Transaction Type] = 3
        AND A.[Receipt Status]   = 2
        AND COALESCE(A.[Inbound Quantity],0) > 0
        AND A.[Date Physical] >= DATEADD(DAY, -14, CONVERT(date, GETDATE()))
)
SELECT *
FROM Transfer_and_Movement
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM PurchaseOrder
ORDER BY
    [Transaction Date] DESC,
    ActivityType,
    [Inventory Location ID],
    [Item ID],
    [Inventory Batch ID]
description: Complex CTE-based query returns transfer, movement, and purchase order activities from the last 14 days. Filters by specific user list (inventory personnel) and locations (BT, BT-OPS). Company = 'rdsi'. Results ordered by Transaction Date descending.

sqlStatement:
SELECT ITEMID,
  [Mass / Volume (UOM)],
  [Mass / Volume (UOM Clean)]
FROM [dbo].[INVENTTABLE_V]
WHERE [DATAAREAID] = 'rdsi'
description: Retrieves unit of measurement and mass/volume information for inventory items. Filters for company 'rdsi'. Removes duplicate rows.
